subject: My shinyapp.io grays out when I launch it

messages.author: 7cb7c8da92c21bfe
messages.subject: My shinyapp.io grays out when I launch it
parts:
Hi all,

My shinyapp works totally fine locally. I deployed it to the server and it gives me the UI, but screen goes gray and it does not do what it is supposed to do. What can I do?

messages.author: 686ab6dc2c630995
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] My shinyapp.io grays out when I launch it
parts:
HI Taehee,
There are a lot of reasons why a screen goes gray. The most common ones i see is that theres a crash in the R code, or your instance runs out of memory. What is your app url?

Can i see the output of

shinyapps::showLogs()
shinyapps::sessionInfo()
